title: All About Growing
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, ow, oi, ear added, 47-sound stage.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling digging with his bill in dark soil in a vegetable patch.
Ned the duckling dropping a small round seed into a hole in the soil.
Close view of the small seed resting at the bottom of the hole, soil pressed gently over it.
A split scene: bright sun warming the soil on one side, light rain falling on it on the other.
A cut-away view under the soil showing a thin root growing down from the seed.
A tiny green shoot poking up out of the soil into the sunshine.
A tall, leafy vegetable plant standing in the vegetable patch, much bigger than the first shoot.
Ned the duckling happily nibbling a piece of vegetable pulled from the patch.
